requirements.text: Integrate features such as real-time transaction notifications and easy account access to enhance customer experience.
Implement robust data protection measures, including encryption during data transmission and strict access controls, to comply with GDPR.
Ensure all customer financial data remains within the European Economic Area to comply with GDPR regulations.
Develop new features that work with the existing core banking system without requiring modifications to the mainframe.
Monitor customer feedback regarding security and trust, along with maintaining compliance, to measure the success of the modernised app.
